description: Unify issue workflow profile selection into a single persisted fact consistent across create, update, read, startup, and entry surfaces (server, CLI, Web).

tasks.title: Persist workflow profile selection on the Issue aggregate with centralized effective-profile resolution
tasks.description: Add a nullable WorkflowProfileId property to Domain.Issue (JSON-serialized, null = inherit default) with a ReplaceWorkflowProfile transition method. Introduce a single EffectiveWorkflowProfileResolver (issue selection -> project default -> system default) and rewire IssueQuerier.ToInfo to project the resolved value instead of hardcoding IssueWorkflowProfiles.DefaultId. All read paths (detail, list, workflow-profile response) call this resolver so they cannot diverge.
acceptanceCriteria: Domain.Issue exposes a nullable WorkflowProfileId that round-trips through IssueStore serialization/deserialization
IssueQuerier.ToInfo projects the effective profile via the centralized resolver and no longer hardcodes the default id
An issue with no stored selection resolves to mohist/default on detail, list, and workflow-profile endpoints
Server build succeeds (dotnet build Mohist.sln) with warnings-as-errors
Unit tests cover: null selection resolves to default, explicit selection projects to all read surfaces, unknown id handling
tasks.output: Updated Domain.Issue, EffectiveWorkflowProfileResolver, IssueQuerier read projection, and accompanying unit tests
tasks.notes: Foundation task — every other task depends on this persisted fact and resolver. No DB schema migration; the field is additive/null-safe.

tasks.title: Wire create to persist workflow profile and add PATCH update with started-issue guard
tasks.description: Extend IIssueGrain.CreateAsync/CreateAsync with a workflowProfileId parameter and pass req.WorkflowProfileId from the POST handler (validate existence via IssueWorkflowProfileRegistry.Exists, 400 on unknown). Add WorkflowProfileId to UpdateIssueData and UpdateFullAsync using the existing raw-presence-aware three-state semantics (absent=unchanged, present-null=clear, present-value=replace), and capture workflowProfileId presence in UpdateIssueRequest.BindAsync. Reject workflowProfileId changes with 409 when the issue has an ActiveWorkflowRunId; leave variable/prompt endpoints untouched.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/issues with workflowProfileId=mohist/pr persists the selection and GET returns mohist/pr
POST without workflowProfileId leaves no issue-level selection and reads resolve to default
POST with an unknown profile id returns 400
PATCH with present workflowProfileId replaces the selection; absent preserves it; present-null clears to inherit-default
PATCH changing workflowProfileId on an issue with an active workflow run returns 409 with a clear reason and leaves the selection unchanged
PUT /api/issues/:n/workflow-profile/variables on a started issue still succeeds (runtime override unaffected)
Configured workflow profile variables/prompts/model overlays remain unchanged after a profile selection update
dotnet build succeeds; API regression tests cover create round-trip, default->PR switch read-model agreement, started-issue rejection, variable-overlay preservation
tasks.output: Updated IssueGrain, IIssueGrain, IssueRoutes.Crud/Helpers/Dtos, UpdateIssueData, and API regression tests
tasks.notes: Reuses the established raw-presence PATCH contract from the http-api spec. Implements design decisions D3 and D5.

tasks.title: Resolve startup workflow definition from the effective profile and align the workflow-profile endpoint response
tasks.description: In IssueGrain.StartWorkflowAsync, resolve the effective profile via the centralized resolver and use _profiles.Get(effectiveProfileId).Definition as the base definition; the advanced custom-YAML/project-template override (WorkflowProfileManager.LoadTemplateAsync) continues to take precedence when present. Merge prompts from the selected profile rather than unconditionally the default. Align BuildIssueWorkflowProfileResponseAsync so ProfileId is reported from the issue's effective profile (not recomputed from template state), while still surfacing Yaml/HasCustomTemplate/TemplateSource for overrides.
acceptanceCriteria: Starting an issue whose effective profile is mohist/pr uses the PR workflow definition and enters the PR publish/merge path
Starting an issue whose effective profile is mohist/default uses the default workflow definition and enters the default merge/push path
GET /api/issues/:n/workflow-profile ProfileId matches the effective profile returned by GET /api/issues/:n and the list endpoint
A custom YAML override still takes precedence at startup and is surfaced via HasCustomTemplate/TemplateSource without changing the displayed selection
dotnet build succeeds; tests cover PR-profile startup, default-profile startup, and endpoint agreement
tasks.output: Updated IssueGrain.StartWorkflowAsync, IssueRoutes.Helpers response builder, and startup/endpoint tests
tasks.notes: Implements design decisions D4 and D6. Keeps the custom-YAML escape hatch intact.

tasks.title: Add CLI workflow-profile flag to update and verify show rendering
tasks.description: Add --workflow-profile <id> to `mo issue update` sending workflowProfileId in the PATCH body (present-null clears the selection); omit the key when the flag is absent. Verify `mo issue create --workflow-profile` (already sent) now round-trips and `mo issue show` displays the effective profile. Surface server started-issue rejections as the server message with a non-zero exit code.
acceptanceCriteria: `mo issue create --workflow-profile mohist/pr` then `mo issue show <n>` displays mohist/pr
`mo issue update <n> --workflow-profile mohist/pr` updates the selection and `mo issue show` reflects it
`mo issue update <n` without --workflow-profile omits the key and preserves the existing selection
`mo issue update <n> --workflow-profile mohist/pr` on a started issue prints the server error and exits non-zero
CLI typecheck and tests pass
tasks.output: Updated MohistCliCommands.Issue.cs (update flag), show rendering, and CLI tests
tasks.notes: Create already sends workflowProfileId (MohistCliCommands.Issue.cs:242); once T-002 persists it, create behavior is correct with no create-side change beyond verification.

tasks.title: Unify Web workflow-profile selection across create, issue detail, and workflow-profile page
tasks.description: Ensure the create dialog, issue detail, and IssueWorkflowProfileEditor read the effective profile from the unified issue read model / workflow-profile response so they never diverge. Add a control on issue detail to change the selection on backlog/ready issues, disabled with an explanatory message when the issue has started. Keep custom YAML editing distinct from the profile selection.
acceptanceCriteria: Selecting mohist/pr in the create dialog results in the created issue detail displaying mohist/pr
Issue detail, workflow-profile page, and issue list all display the same effective profile for a given issue
Changing the profile from the issue detail on a backlog issue updates all surfaces to the new value
Attempting to change the profile on a started issue surfaces a clear error and leaves the selection unchanged
Creating an issue without selecting a profile displays the inherited default
Web typecheck and tests pass
tasks.output: Updated CreateIssueDialog, IssueDetailPage, IssueWorkflowProfileEditor bindings, and Web tests
tasks.notes: Create dialog already binds workflowProfileId; main work is reading the unified fact and adding the detail-page change control.
